name: progress
useFor: Use for a known amount of work the agent reports (Loading terrain, sources read, parcels matched). Give it a label, which names the bar and shows the percentage; without one, pass aria-label. The fill counts up a tick at a time. For a wait with no known end, use Spinner.
constraints: Progress for something that takes under a second

title: Progress
description: A determinate tick bar: 1px lines every 6px, Forest where done and Stone ahead, under a 16px title and its percentage.
